item.title: Indore water contamination deaths rise to eight, officials suspended
item.description: The death toll linked to suspected water contamination in Indore has risen to eight, prompting the Madhya Pradesh government to take disciplinary action against three officials and order a detailed investigation into the incident.

item.title: Delhi-NCR New Year’s Eve alert: Traffic restrictions in place, plan your travel and parking ahead
item.description: Delhi-NCR gears up for New Year’s Eve with strict traffic curbs and heavy police deployment in Connaught Place, India Gate and Gurugram. Stay informed, park only in designated spots and celebrate safely

item.title: Bangladesh prepares state funeral for former prime minister Khaleda Zia
item.description: Bangladesh will bid a final farewell to Khaleda Zia, the country’s first female prime minister and longtime chief of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), with a state funeral in Dhaka on Wednesday, a day after her death at the age of 80.

item.title: Assam: Voter base grows by 1.35% in integrated draft electoral roll ahead of Assembly polls
item.description: Assam’s voter list grows by 1.35%. With over 2.52 crore electors in the draft roll ahead of 2026 assembly polls, public claims and objections open till 22 January.

item.title: Stalin uses New Year message to attack Centre, calls for ‘Dravidian Pongal’ celebrations
item.description: Tamil Nadu CM M K Stalin used his New Year message to attack the Centre over the NEP, urging DMK cadres to organise ‘Dravidian Pongal’ celebrations as part of preparations for the 2026 Assembly elections.

item.title: Dense fog disrupts flight operations at Delhi airport
item.description: Flight operations at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport were severely disrupted on Wednesday after dense fog and poor visibility led to widespread cancellations and delays.

item.title: Zohran Mamdani to take oath as New York City mayor in historic subway ceremony at the stroke of midnight
item.description: New York City rings in 2026 as Zohran Mamdani will take oath as mayor in a unique midnight subway ceremony and a public City Hall celebration.

item.title: Thailand releases 18 Cambodian soldiers under renewed border ceasefire
item.description: Thailand on Wednesday released 18 Cambodian soldiers who had been held since July, following the implementation of a renewed ceasefire agreed by the two countries over the weekend to end a protracted border conflict.

item.title: Arjun Erigaisi’s double-bronze augurs well for India in faster formats
item.description: Arjun Erigaisi’s double bronze at the World Rapid and Blitz Championships in Doha signals India’s next-gen arrival on the global stage. At 22, he’s only the second Indian man after Vishy Anand to podium in both open formats.

item.title: Jairam Ramesh questions China’s mediation claim on Operation Sindoor, seeks PM’s clarity
item.description: Senior Congress leader Jairam Ramesh has raised concerns over China’s claim of mediating to halt Operation Sindoor in May 2025, urging the Prime Minister to clarify the government’s stand on a sensitive national security issue.
